charts.title: Penn Endowment Annual Returns: FY2022-FY2026
charts.sourceText: Penn Office of Investments / Daily Pennsylvanian, Sep 2026
charts.footnote: All figures from Penn Office of Investments. FY2026 return of 27.4% is the second-best in Penn history behind FY2021 (41.1%).

charts.title: NAFSA Fall 2026: Projected International Graduate Enrollment Change by Institution Quartile
charts.sourceText: NAFSA / JB International, Fall 2026 Enrollment Outlook
charts.footnote: Quartiles based on share of total U.S. international student population. Quartile 1 = institutions with largest international cohorts (includes most Ivy League). All figures are projected midpoints from NAFSA range estimates.

charts.title: Yale Endowment Tax: Before and After One Big Beautiful Bill Act
charts.footnote: Yale's endowment tax jumped from $52M (FY2026, pre-new law) to $299M (FY2027, post-One Big Beautiful Bill Act). Net cost increase of $247M this fiscal year. Tax rate rose from 1.4% to 8% on Yale's endowment income.
